q: Is the imaging study design, use case and clinical role of the AI stated?
hint: Screening, triage, diagnosis, prediction; standalone vs assistive.

q: Are image acquisition, devices, protocols and preprocessing described?
hint: Scanner models, parameters, harmonisation, annotation procedure.

q: Is the reference standard defined and its reliability assessed?
hint: Ground truth, reader experience, adjudication, inter-reader agreement.

q: Is the train/validation/test split at patient level with no leakage?
hint: Split by patient/site/time; test set locked before tuning.

q: Was testing done on an independent (external) imaging cohort?
hint: Different centre, scanner or time period.

q: Are imaging-appropriate metrics reported with CIs?
hint: AUC, sensitivity/specificity at stated thresholds, calibration; no cherry-picked operating point.

q: Is the AI compared against a sensible baseline or clinician readers?
hint: Baseline model and/or reader study with stated experience.

q: Are failure cases, subgroups and robustness shown?
hint: Error montage, subgroup performance, image-quality sensitivity.

q: Are code, model weights and data availability stated?
Do clinical claims stay within the tested setting?
